verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for an email-marketing SaaS, but the evidence pack never documents an account or subscriber export feature, or any open-format download (such as CSV or JSON). The paginated list endpoints and the full-record broadcast endpoint are developer building blocks from which a user could assemble an export, not an export capability itself. "Free migrations" refers to moving data into Kit, not out of it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
